subject: Post-call summary: Dedicated inference fit, isolation needs & fallback plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Devon Clarke <devon.clarke@theracore.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference, mina.haddad@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call summary: Dedicated inference fit, isolation needs & fallback plan

Hi Devon — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our call + clear next steps so your team and procurement have everything in one place.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Primary pain: inference variance under load — p95 latency spikes hurting real-time triage across 2 model families (base large LLM + tuned reranker).
- Data-sensitivity: PHI-adjacent features require stronger isolation and customer-managed KMS for keys.
- Scale target: 250 concurrent real-time sessions at 512 tokens average; occasional batch workloads overnight (up to 10k requests).
- Business goal: predictable per-token cost, <150ms p95 for the reranker path, and guaranteed throughput during morning peak.

Redwood recommended configuration (initial qualification)
- Dedicated pool: 6xA100-equivalent GPUs reserved (tenant-isolated pool) to meet the 250 concurrent realtime SLO with room for KV cache efficiency.
- Isolation: single-tenant pool with VPC peering + customer KMS. We propose network-level isolation + audit log forwarding to your SIEM.
- Burst strategy: short-lived burst capacity to a shared bursting tier for overnight batch spikes; automatic fallback to a lower-cost quantized variant if core pool saturated.
- SLA targets: 99.5% uptime for the dedicated pool, latency SLOs to be defined per-route (proposed reranker p95 <150ms).

Open asks / next steps
1) Dev metrics: can you share a 7-day sample traffic profile (timestamped QPS + token distributions) so we can refine sizing? (Procurement or infra team can S3 link).
2) Security: confirmation that customer-managed KMS + SOC2 attestation cover your compliance needs.
3) Commercial: would you prefer a monthly reserved commitment or 12-month term? We assigned a provisional cost range in the attached sizing file.
4) Tech deep-dive: propose a 60-min ops session with Rishi + Mina next week to finalize fallback/quantization tradeoffs.

Attachments: Redwood_SLA-draft-TC-v1.pdf (SLA sketch), isolation-sizing-estimate.xlsx (provisional numbers).

If this looks right I can loop in procurement contacts on our side and start a draft MSA/redlines path.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0128

From: Devon Clarke <devon.clarke@theracore.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@theracore.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call summary: Dedicated inference fit, isolation needs & fallback plan

Soojin — thanks for the clear write-up. Confirming a few things:

- The 250 concurrent sessions figure matches our internal numbers; I will export the 7-day QPS/token CSV and drop it to the S3 link by EOD Thursday.
- PHI-adjacent: customer-managed KMS is a hard requirement; SOC2 is required but we will need the specific audit date / cert copy.
- Procurement preference: leaning toward a 12-month reserved commitment if the SLA and pricing look reasonable.

A couple of clarifying Qs:
1) For the proposed 6 GPUs, do you include headroom for model warm-up and KV cache priming? Any recommendation on minimum pre-warm period?
2) How does the burst fallback affect pricing visibility for us (we need predictable monthly billing for forecasting)?

I'll get the data to you and loop my infra lead (procurement@theracore.ai will include finance).

Regards,
Devon Clarke
VP Product | TheraCore
devon.clarke@theracore.ai | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Devon Clarke <devon.clarke@theracore.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference, mina.haddad@redwood.inference, procurement@theracore.ai
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call summary: Dedicated inference fit, isolation needs & fallback plan

Devon — great, thanks. Short answers:
- Yes, the 6-GPU provisional sizing includes ~15% headroom for cache warming and short peaks. If your workload shows heavy model-switching we may bump to 7 GPUs. The pre-warm window is typically 10–30 minutes depending on model size; we can automate steady-state warming via a lightweight traffic generator on deployment.
- Pricing for burst: we model burst as usage on a separate metered pool with a hard cap; for forecasting we provide an "expected monthly spend" with a burst cap line item. If you prefer cost predictability we can add a monthly burst-allowance to the reserved agreement (fixed-dollar bucket).

Attached is the SLA sketch (Redwood_SLA-draft-TC-v1.pdf) — highlights: 99.5% dedicated pool availability, incident response tiers, and credit calculation. The isolation-sizing-estimate.xlsx includes cost buckets for 6 vs 7 GPU configurations and scenarios with/without a burst allowance.

Action items I’ll own:
- R1: Collect your 7-day traffic CSV (Devon) — due Thu EOD (I’ll ping if not received).
- R2: Schedule ops deep-dive with Rishi/Mina — proposed Thu 09:30 PT or Fri 08:30 PT.
- R3: Draft commercial term with optional monthly burst bucket and deliver preliminary MSAs for procurement to review.

If procurement needs a certificate or SOC2 evidence I can route the SOC2 artifact (audit report) and KMS integration checklist to your security contact.

Best,
Soojin

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference, mina.haddad@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call summary: Dedicated inference fit, isolation needs & fallback plan — ops prep

FYI forwarding Devon's confirms + our proposed sizing/attachments. Please review the attached isolation-sizing-estimate.xlsx and SLA sketch before the ops deep-dive. Key engineering asks to scope:
- Validation plan for KV cache hit-rates and pre-warm tooling (owner: Mina)
- Fallback quantized build: perf delta assessment and compatibility checklist (owner: Rishi)
- Telemetry & audit log forwarding specifics for TheraCore SIEM (owner: Rishi)

I'll book an invite once you both confirm availability: proposed Thu 09/10 09:30 PT.

Thanks — Soojin
